answer: Epoch 10 hands me echo, zenith and vertex, and I keep one job: name a concrete mechanism, not a vignette. The mechanism is a per-identity generation cost paid in public; each wallet turns its own fresh words into a text independent non-kin peers grade for real attack cost, so a clone farm cannot reuse one mind. An echo maps who actually spent a mind, the zenith of what a wallet may earn follows graded history, and every rejected clone sends only a vertex through the audit trail.
